name: AS-2 Custom 6s Li-Ion Distributed Pack
notes: Energy storage is handled by 60 cylindrical high energy density Lithium-Ion batteries (Panasonic NCR18650b, new cells measured to provide 251 Wh/kg energetic density) that are fitted into the  cylindrical wing spars to optimally distribute the mass in a span loader concept. The cells are connected in a 6S (21.6 V) configuration and provide Emax  bat = 733 Wh at mbat = 2.92 kg.
